title: Warehouse collapse in Kolkata traps dozens, deaths feared
summary: A warehouse shed collapsed in Taratala, West Bengal, trapping numerous workers. Reports indicate injuries and potential fatalities while rescue operations involving army personnel are underway.
summary_points: Reports describe a large-scale accident where the roof of an under-construction warehouse or factory shed fell in Kolkata's Taratala area.
title_hi: कोलकाता में गोदाम ढहा: दबे मजदूर, मौतों की आशंका
